script_hooks.logic:
If condition flag v3 is up this frame, then set the register's 'soulSphereAroundCount' to 0.
If condition flag v2 is up this frame, then increase the register's 'soulSphereAroundCount' by one.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
  Let v4 be data at currentParamSuffixNo.
  If the numeric entry v4 in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is at most the register's 'soulSphereAroundCount', then the enemy uses the move labelled "kyo_angry_roar" and stop.
  The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

flow.text: condition flag v3 is up this frame
condition flag v2 is up this frame
the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let v4 be data at currentParamSuffixNo.
the numeric entry v4 in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is at most the register's 'soulSphereAroundCount'
The enemy uses the move labelled "kyo_angry_roar".
The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

helpers.name: data2
helpers.logic: {conditionFlagTag: v2, condition: {class: "AbilityCountTransitCondition", args: {abilityTag: "area_soul_sphere", whenDone: true, count: 1}}}

helpers.name: data3
helpers.logic: {conditionFlagTag: v3, condition: {class: "AbilityCountTransitCondition", args: {abilityTag: "kyo_angry_roar", whenDone: true, count: 1}}}
